content.overview: Section 4 is the charging provision: income-tax is charged for the assessment year at the rates in force on the total income of the previous year of every person.
content.glance: Section 4 is the charging provision: income-tax is charged for the assessment year at the rates in force on the total income of the previous year of every person.
content.study: Section 4 charges income-tax for each assessment year, at the rates enacted for that year, on the total income of the previous year of every person. It is the charging section; computation follows the later heads and deduction provisions.

sections.heading: Operative rule
sections.body: Section 4 is the charging provision: income-tax is charged for the assessment year at the rates in force on the total income of the previous year of every person.

distinctions.title: Scope of ita-s-4
distinctions.body: Applies only within the elements and consequences stated in the statutory text.

misconceptions.myth: ita-s-4 creates unlimited or extra-statutory rights.
misconceptions.correction: It operates only as stated in the provision.
